script.text: Okay, straight to the point today.
Making these animations solo takes forever—I'm drawing every single frame by hand at this desk until three in the morning.
And honestly, it gets pretty lonely sitting in this room by myself.
So, I finally set up a Discord server! It's called Nemi's Little Corner.
You can come hang out, play games with us, share your art, pitch story ideas, or just chill quietly. The invite link is in the description.
Also, a lot of you asked how to support me financially so I can keep animating, so I set up a Ko-fi page.
Zero pressure, seriously—just watching these videos and leaving nice comments already means the world to me.
But if you are able to tip, that financial support directly helps me get a better device for animation, support my family, and become independent.
Both links are right down below. Thank you so much for being here, and I'll see you in the next story.
